newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Parliament held a joint session to appoint the members of Romania's delegations to various international organisations and to name an interim chairman of the state television.

* Parliament also adopted President Emil Constantinescu's proposal for the deployment of Romanian troops to Bosnia to join the Stabilisation Force (SFOR) there. Romania will send an engineer batallion and will put facilities on the western Timisoara airport at SFOR's disposal.
* The Greater Romania Party MPs voted against the decision to deploy troops.
* The lower Chamber of Deputies voted to allow the government to rule by decree during parliament's recess.

* The centrist ruling alliance made of the Democratic Convention, the Social Democratic Union and the Hungarian Democratic Union will last until the year 2000, the national Liberal Party head Mircea Ionescu-Quintus said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
